content: We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. We have no explicit structure given. Possibly we need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons? But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the sample is "the compound at hand" which is implicit. We need to get carbon NMR to see aromatic carbon signals. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. That will give list of chemical shifts. Aromatic carbons typically 110-160 ppm. Count number of signals in that range. Let's call tool.
